LAREDO, Texas — The United Independent School District board has authorized staff to negotiate a right-of-entry allowing the U.S. Border Patrol and U.S. Customs and Border Protection to conduct surveying and site assessments on identified Webb County parcels, according to a public summary of the board’s Oct. 21 action.

The board voted to authorize legal counsel to proceed as discussed in closed session. The agenda item listed Webb County tax-assessor parcel identification numbers in the record, but the public summary does not say which parcels are involved or what the surveying and site assessments are for.

That gap matters. A right-of-entry is a limited permission — it allows access for a stated purpose, such as surveying land — but when the purpose and the parcels are not spelled out in public, residents and parents are left to guess what federal agencies would be doing on or near school-district-connected land, and for how long.

UISD is one of the largest public landholders and employers in Webb County, and its campuses serve families across Laredo, Rio Bravo, and El Cenizo. Any arrangement that brings federal border enforcement activity onto district-associated property deserves a public explanation: what is being assessed, where, and what happens with the findings.

Webb Watch 956 will keep watching for the district to release those details — the parcels, the purpose of the assessments, and any timeline — and for any follow-up board action. If the district publishes the agreement or discusses it in open session, we will update this story.

Sources: Public summary of United ISD board action, Oct. 21, 2026 (Citizen Portal).

Webb Watch 956
excerpt: The United ISD board voted Oct. 21 to authorize negotiation of a right-of-entry for Border Patrol and CBP surveying and site assessments on identified Webb County parcels; the public record does not yet say which parcels or for what purpose.
title: UISD board authorizes Border Patrol, CBP right-of-entry for site assessments — but which parcels, and why, remain undisclosed
